description: Check whether an EU VAT number is valid and active. Returns validity, registered name and address where the member state publishes them. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

vat.description: VAT number with country prefix, e.g. DK10150817. Spaces and dots are ignored. Greece uses EL, Northern Ireland XI.

name: eu_vat_validate
title: EU VAT Number Validator
